hub.title: Starteach — Digital Product Hub
hub.subtitle: Start Each: every project, a fresh beginning
hub.description: I am the founder of Starteach (starteach.ir). Instead of building a separate brand and website for every idea, I develop all products under one umbrella brand with identities rooted in Starteach. Starteach is a project hub — from education and software to media and tools — with the goal of Start Each: a fresh start for learning, building, and growth. Today my main focus is developing and commercializing this platform.

philosophy.title: From perfectionism to action
philosophy.text: I am always committed to upgrading my skills and learning, but I shifted from perfectionism to action. Instead of waiting for an ideal day that may never come, I start with what I have, solve challenges through different approaches, and treat every decision as the best decision at that moment. If I later realize it was wrong, I fix it — without getting stuck in the past.

projects.name: FishNote — Research Assistant
projects.summary: Specialized platform for storing research notes with categorization, indexing, and detailed metadata for researchers.
projects.role: Designer and Lead Developer — Creating a platform for intelligent organization of research notes.
projects.vision: Building an integrated ecosystem for researchers to manage their notes exclusively, categorized, and with fast retrieval capabilities.
process: Analyzing researchers' needs in resource management
Designing data structure for research notes
Implementing intelligent indexing and tagging system
Developing simple yet powerful user interface
Launching initial version and gathering feedback
projects.marketing: Introduction in research communities, universities, and academic groups.
projects.seo: Research notes, research management, research assistant software.
projects.content: Ability to register notes with full details, subject categorization, advanced search, and standard outputs.
projects.challenges: Diversity of research formats; solved by designing flexible structure and custom fields.
projects.outcomes: Reduced time in organizing resources, increased research productivity, and quick access to notes.
